title: A subgroup inclusion admits an equivariant set retraction
statement: Let G be any group and H any subgroup. There exists a function r : G → H such that r(hg) = h r(g) for every h ∈ H and g ∈ G, and r(h) = h for every h ∈ H, where elements of H are included in G when necessary. No finiteness or normality assumption is imposed, and r is not required to be a group homomorphism.
lean_statement: ∀ {G : Type _} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G), ∃ r : G → H, (∀ (h : H) (g : G), r ((h : G) * g) = h * r g) ∧ ∀ h : H, r (h : G) = h
